title: Data Architect
description:
**The Role**
We are building our enterprise data platform from the ground up and need a Data Architect to own it. This is a greenfield, hands-on leadership role — not a consulting engagement. You will define the architecture, make the
  
technology decisions, build the foundation, and be accountable for outcomes. You will report directly to the CTO and
  
partner closely with a Senior Data Engineer on the same hiring cycle. The platform will serve business analytics, operational reporting, and AI-driven capabilities across multiple markets andenterprise clients. A key deliverable is enabling AI applications and agents to consume trusted enterprise data securely viaAPIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Data platform architecture — Data Lake, Lakehouse, semantic layers, and data consumption patterns across
  
structured, semi-structured, and event-based sources.
  
Ingestion and transformation pipelines — batch, streaming, and CDC-based, with proper orchestration, observability, and failure handling.
  
Data modelling — scalable analytical models covering core business domains: orders, inventory, fulfilment,
  
logistics, marketplaces, billing, and platform performance.
  
Business analytics — governed KPI definitions, dashboards, and self-service capabilities that replace manual
  
reporting.
  
AI data enablement — architecture for exposing authoritative, governed data to AI agents through MCP and APIs, with appropriate access controls and tenant isolation.
  
Data governance and compliance — data quality, lineage, PII classification, and controls that meet enterprise
  
security and privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  
Platform reliability — monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a
  
production service.
  
  
**What We Expect**
First 90 days: Weeks 1–4: Assess the data landscape, produce an enterprise architecture proposal.
  
Weeks 5–8: Deliver the first production pipeline and a priority BI dashboard.
  
Weeks 9–12: Define common KPI models for two business domains and deliver the first MCP-based data capability for an AI agent.
  
6–12 months: Production data platform operational with automated pipelines for priority datasets.
  
Governed business models and trusted KPI definitions in active use by the business.
  
Dashboards live and replacing manual reporting. Architecture for secure AI data consumption implemented, with initial MCP capabilities in production.
  
Platform operational practices — quality, lineage, monitoring, cost controls — established and running.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
10+ years across data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture — with real architecture ownership, not just
  
delivery.
  
Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lake, Warehouse, or Lakehouse platforms.
  
Strong SQL, data modelling, pipeline design, and cloud-native (preferably AWS) skills.
  
Experience with governance, data quality, lineage, and compliance — including PII and privacy controls.
  
Hands-on enough to validate designs and build in the early phase; structured enough to define standards that
  
scale.
  
Experience in eCommerce, logistics, marketplace, or B2B SaaS is strongly preferred — the domain is complex and
  
ramp time matters.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Practical experience with MCP, LLM/AI integration, semantic layers, RAG, or secure enterprise data access for AI systems.
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a founding role. The data platform does not yet exist. You will define what good looks like at Anchanto — and build
  
it.
  
If you are energised by greenfield architecture, comfortable with high ownership, and capable of moving fluently from
  
business question to data pipeline to AI consumption — we want to talk.
  
  
  
Benefits
  
  
  
**Why Join Anchanto**
  
  
  

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.

* **Global Exposure:**
  Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* **Learning & Development:**
  We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* **International & Onsite Opportunities:**
  Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* **Medical Insurance:**
  Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support you & your families health and well-being.
* **Comprehensive Leave Benefits:**
  Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* **Recognition for Long-Term Contribution:**
  Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:**
  A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* **Meaningful Career Growth:**
  Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: ML Operations Lead
description:
# Job Title: ML Operations Lead
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 18–25 Years overall
* Relevant Experience:\*\* 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadership
* Location:\*\* Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune
* Work Mode:\*\* 5 Days Work from Office
* Working Hours:\*\* 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)

## Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.
  
  
The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.
  
  

* Note:\*\* This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.

## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices.
* Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production.
* Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production.
* Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required.
* Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio.
* Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability.
* Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records.
* Track model performance using relevant metrics such as AUC, precision, recall, and other business-aligned KPIs.
* Monitor model bias and fairness, ensuring appropriate controls and human oversight for sensitive decision-making use cases.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to manage data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and upstream data changes.
* Implement business-requested model changes within agreed timelines while maintaining operational and validation standards.
* Coordinate with international stakeholders on deployment schedules, production incidents, change management, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success rates, retraining outcomes, and overall portfolio performance.
* Support predictive ML use cases such as customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.

##
**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong experience in \*\*MLOps and production ML operations\*\*.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating traditional Machine Learning models in production.
* Strong understanding of \*\*customer churn prediction models\*\* and related predictive analytics use cases.
* Expertise in model deployment, model monitoring, drift detection, and model retraining.
* Experience implementing ML CI/CD pipelines, model registries, and model lineage.
* Practical experience with data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model decay management.
* Experience with model validation, backtesting, and champion-challenger methodologies.
* Knowledge of model performance metrics, including AUC, precision, recall, and precision-recall evaluation.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and managing operational priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including cross-border collaboration.
* Ability to translate business requirements into operational priorities and deliver model changes within agreed timelines.
* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience in telecommunications (telco) or large-scale data environments.
* Exposure to fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting models.
* Experience with cloud-based Machine Learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with model governance, auditability, responsible AI, bias monitoring, and model-risk management.

## Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Ability to lead a lean ML Operations team and establish scalable operating practices.
* Strong operational judgment and ownership of production model health.
* Effective coordination with business, data, and platform stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of stability in an organization.
* Immediate joiners and candidates currently serving notice are preferred.
* Candidates based in Pune are preferred.
* Willingness to work from the office five days a week in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune.
* Excellent communication skills are essential due to regular stakeholder and client interaction.

## Interview Process
  
  

* 2 Technical Rounds
* 1 Client Round
* HR Round

Skills: feature drift,model deployment,drift detection,metrics,auc,machine learning models,model monitoring,model validation,mlops,production ml operations,backtesting,ml ci/cd pipelines,model registries,stakeholder-management,concept drift,data drift,customer churn prediction models

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Solutions Architect
description:

You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.

 is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. **Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
  
  
The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
  
  

* Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer – AI & Automation
description:

5+ years

InCommon helps global startups and businesses build, manage, and scale their teams in India.

We partner with growing companies to support their expansion through talent acquisition, Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup, compliance, payroll, and business operations.

Founded in 2023 and backed by Better Capital, InCommon works closely with companies to build strong teams across technology, AI, product, and leadership roles.

* Design integration architecture across Salesforce and other enterprise systems.

title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
description:
****Job Summary:****
Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.
  
  
Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  
  
Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.
  
  
Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.
  
  
Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.
  
  
Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.
  
  
Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.
  
  
Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.
  
  
Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Intermediate level relevant work experience required.
  
  
**Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior**
**Role Summary:**
We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
* Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
* Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
* Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
* Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
* Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
* Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.

****Required Skills & Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
* Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
* Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional plant teams and translating shop-floor challenges into analytics or AI use cases.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project execution skills.

****Preferred Experience****

* Experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, connected factory, MES, ERP, or digital manufacturing platforms.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced operations analytics in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading value stream improvement, or data-driven productivity projects.
* Ability to influence plant stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics-based improvement actions.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a experienced AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy machine learning models and intelligent systems that solve real business problems at scale. This role has a strong focus on modern generative AI — building LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI systems — alongside classical ML. You will work across the full ML/AI lifecycle, from data exploration and model development to production deployment and monitoring, partnering closely with Data Science, Product, and Platform Engineering teams. This role suits someone who enjoys turning research and prototypes into reliable, production-grade systems.
  
  
You will be reporting to Team Lead-IT
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows to automate and augment business processes.
* Stay current with the latest ML/AI research (including LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems) and evaluate applicability to company use cases.
* Document architectures, experiments, and decisions; contribute to internal ML standards, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure responsible AI practices — fairness, explainability, privacy, and security — are embedded throughout model development
* Build and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines for feature engineering, model training, and inference (batch and real-time).
* Deploy models into production using MLOps best practices — CI/CD for ML, containerization, model versioning, and automated retraining pipelines.
* Monitor deployed models for drift, performance degradation, bias, and data quality issues; implement retraining and alerting strategies.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure clean, reliable, and well-governed data is available for model development.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions and model capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs.
* Conduct experiments (A/B tests, offline evaluation) to validate model performance and business impact.
* Optimize models for latency, throughput, and cost (quantization, distillation, pruning, efficient inference serving).

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production (adjust based on seniority: 5–8+ years for Senior/Staff level).

**Technical Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with SQL
* Proficiency with ML/DL frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM.
* 5+ years of experience with the ML lifecycle: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with MLOps tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Airflow, or similar for experiment tracking, orchestration, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, and core ML/DL algorithms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray, Dask) and data pipeline/orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster).
* 5+ years of experience with model serving and APIs (FastAPI/Flask, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or similar).
* Version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for ML systems.

Generative AI, LLMs & Agentic Applications (Essential)
  
  

* Hands-on experience building applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) — e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama, Mistral, or Gemini APIs.
* Practical experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building agentic AI systems / multi-step autonomous workflows (tool use, function calling, planning, orchestration) using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
* Working knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus, Chroma) for semantic search and retrieval at scale.
* Experience with prompt engineering, evaluation, and fine-tuning/adapting LLMs (LoRA, PEFT) for domain-specific use cases.
* Understanding of the trade-offs, latency, cost, and safety considerations of deploying LLM- and agent-based applications in production.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Experience deploying and scaling multi-agent systems in production (orchestration, memory, guardrails, observability for agentic workflows).
* Contributions to open-source LLM/RAG tooling, or published work on GenAI applications.
* Publications, open-source contributions, or Kaggle competition experience.
* Experience with real-time/streaming ML systems (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).
* Domain experience relevant to the business (e.g., fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, cybersecurity).
* Understanding of responsible AI, model interpretability (SHAP, LIME), and privacy-preserving ML techniques.

Tools & Technology (Representative)
  
  

* Languages: Python, SQL
* ML/DL: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers
* GenAI / LLM: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/FAISS)
* MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker/Vertex AI/Azure ML, Airflow
* Data: Spark, Pandas, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift
* Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform
* Monitoring: Prometheus/Grafana, Evidently AI, WhyLabs

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes:
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmed with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment
* Company volunteer and donation matching programme
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalised wellbeing programmed through our OnTrack programmed
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* ... and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.
  
  
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
**In a nutshell**

Loylogic created the global rewards marketplace. Today, we are leading its evolution into the AI era - helping organizations recognize, reward and incentivize their most valuable customers, employees and partners with greater intelligence, relevance and impact.

Loylogic is looking for a highly hands-on AI Transformation Lead to help redesign how work gets done across our company. This is not primarily an AI strategy, research or advisory role. We are looking for a builder with a strong business and process mindset: someone who can quickly understand how work happens today, challenge it, simplify it and then use AI agents, automation and modern technology to make the better way of working a reality.

Working directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, you will have the opportunity to work horizontally across the organisation: Commercial - Sales, RevOps, Customer Success; Marketplace – Partnerships, Marketplace – Performance, Platform, and Corporate (Finance, PE, Legal). Our ambition is not to deploy AI for the sake of AI.

It is to make Loylogic a genuinely AI-native company and materially improve how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission can be summarized in five words:

DISCOVER → CHALLENGE → BUILD → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE

* Discover — Get close to our teams and rapidly understand how our most important work actually gets done.
* Challenge — Identify unnecessary work, bottlenecks and complexity. Determine what can be stopped, simplified, automated or fundamentally redesigned.
* Build — Personally prototype AI agents, automations and AI-enabled workflows rather than simply recommending what somebody else should build.
* Implement — Work with our functional teams and Technology to turn successful prototypes into solutions that become part of everyday work.
* Measure — Demonstrate what changed: capacity created, cycle times reduced, quality improved, revenue opportunities enabled, costs avoided and other measurable business outcomes.

***How we think about AI and work***

We don’t assume that every problem needs an AI agent.

Before automating an existing process, we want to understand whether that process should exist in its current form at all.

For the processes you work on, we expect you to think along the lines of:

STOP → SIMPLIFY → AUTOMATE/AGENT → BOOST

* Stop: Does this activity actually need to be done?
* Simplify: Can we make the process fundamentally simpler?
* Automate/Agent: Which activities can AI agents or conventional automation perform reliably?
* BOOST: Where should the person keep the work, with AI making them faster, sharper or better informed?
* Where these changes create meaningful additional capacity, you will help quantify that opportunity so functional leadership can determine how it can best be redirected towards higher-value work.

**What you will do**

You will:

* Rapidly map and understand critical workflows across Loylogic.
* Work directly with functional leaders and the people performing the work.
* Identify and prioritise the highest-value AI and process-transformation opportunities.
* Challenge existing processes before automating them.
* Identify activities that can be eliminated, simplified, automated or AI-augmented.
* Personally prototype and build AI agents, automations and internal tools.
* Integrate solutions with existing systems, data and APIs where appropriate.
* Design appropriate human oversight and escalation into AI-enabled workflows.
* Work closely with Technology to move successful prototypes into secure, reliable and scalable production environments.
* Create reusable components and approaches rather than solving every problem from scratch.
* Help teams adopt new workflows and ways of working.
* Measure the impact of implemented solutions.
* Quantify capacity released and identify opportunities for higher-value use of that capacity.
* Maintain a prioritised pipeline of further transformation opportunities.
* Stay close to developments in agentic AI and rapidly experiment with relevant new capabilities.
* We expect you to build, not just recommend.

***What this could look like in practice***

* You might redesign an RFP process so AI handles research, knowledge retrieval and first-draft creation, allowing Sales to spend more time developing the proposition and engaging the client.
* You could reduce the time Customer Success Managers spend preparing client reporting and QBRs, creating additional capacity for performance analysis, upselling and proactive client engagement.
* You might automate elements of supplier onboarding, catalogue enrichment, management reporting, CRM administration, reconciliation, contract analysis or internal knowledge retrieval.
* Sometimes the right answer will be an AI agent.
* Sometimes it will be conventional automation.
* Sometimes it will simply be a much better process.
* And sometimes the answer will be that a human should continue doing the work — but with much better AI support.
* We expect you to understand the difference.

**What you will do**

We are deliberately not looking for an “AI guru.”

We want an energetic, curious, pragmatic and exceptionally resourceful person who enjoys understanding problems, building solutions and getting them into everyday use.

You will probably have around 2–7 years of relevant professional experience, although demonstrated ability matters considerably more to us than years of experience.

***You should bring a combination of:***

* Strong business-process and problem-solving skills.
* Practical experience applying generative AI and LLMs to real business problems.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents and automated workflows.
* Ability to work with APIs, structured data and business systems.
* Working knowledge of Python or comparable scripting/development capabilities.
* Experience with modern automation/orchestration platforms and AI development tools.
* Understanding of RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompting and agentic architectures.
* An understanding of when human oversight is required in AI-enabled workflows.
* Enough technical depth to build independently while recognizing when enterprise engineering support is required.
* Strong commercial judgement and an ability to prioritize according to business value.
* Excellent communication skills and an ability to understand unfamiliar business areas quickly.
* A strong bias towards experimentation, prototyping and shipping.
* Experience in loyalty is not required. Experience in a fast-moving technology company, SaaS business, marketplace, fintech, scale-up, AI company or entrepreneurial environment would be particularly relevant.

***How you think***

When someone explains a complicated process, your instinct is to ask: “Can you show me how you actually do this today?”

* You don’t automatically assume AI is the answer.
* You first understand the problem, challenge the process and determine the best way of doing the work. Then you build.
* You are equally comfortable discussing a business problem with the CEO or COO, sitting with someone in Finance to understand a reconciliation process, or spending the afternoon building and testing an agent yourself.
* You like autonomy, speed and accountability.

***What this role is not***

This is not a Chief AI Officer role.

* It is not primarily about producing AI strategies, PowerPoint presentations, running innovation workshops or managing large transformation programs.
* Nor is success measured by how many AI agents we deploy.
* This is a hands-on role focused on redesigning work and delivering measurable business outcomes, using AI and automation wherever they are the best tools for the job.

***What success looks like***

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to have developed a practical understanding of the highest-value transformation opportunities across Loylogic, created a prioritized pipeline, redesigned several meaningful workflows and already built and deployed the first AI-enabled solutions.

From there, we will measure success through tangible outcomes including:

* Productivity gained • cycle times reduced • quality improved • commercial capacity created • scalability increased • costs avoided or reduced • employee adoption • measurable revenue opportunities enabled
* Ultimately, we want to combine great people, better processes and increasingly capable AI so that Loylogic can achieve materially more with the organization we have.

**What we offer**

Loylogic is an international business with colleagues, clients and partners located across the world. We combine global scale with an entrepreneurial culture in which people are encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge established thinking and take ownership of meaningful outcomes.

You will join a business shaping the future of AI-powered rewards and engagement, working with recognized global brands and sophisticated loyalty programs across multiple industries and markets. Our goodies for you

Our benefits include:

* Highly-attractive bonus scheme
* Competitive salary dependent on experience
* Hybrid working model (mix of office and home office)
* Own points-based incentive program

And many more benefits.

Platform Administration

* Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls.
* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly.
* Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities.

**Qualifications**
**Seniority:**
Having at least
**5-8**
years of coding experience in above languages,
  
  
B.E/BTech/MTech/MS Computer Science in computer science or equivalent.

* Good understanding of AI/ML concepts.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Role: AI/ML Engineer**

**About Us:**

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at
www.appzen.com
.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an
**AI/ML Engineer**
with 1–3 years of experience to join our growing AI team. In this role, you will build and ship the
**LLM-powered and agentic features**
that read, understand and make decisions on invoices, expense reports and card transactions for some of the world’s largest finance teams. You will work alongside senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists and product managers to take features from prototype to production, and own them once they are live. If you enjoy turning the latest advances in LLMs and agents into reliable and measurable products, AppZen is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **LLM & Agent Development:**
  Build and improve LLM-powered features and multi-step agentic workflows (e.g., using LangGraph) that extract, validate and reason over invoices, receipts, expense reports and card transactions.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):**
  Build retrieval pipelines (chunking, embeddings, vector search and re-ranking) that give models the right policy, vendor and transaction context to make accurate financial decisions.
* **Tool Use & Structured Outputs:**
  Implement function calling and API integrations so that models can reliably query internal services and ERP/AP systems, and return validated, structured (JSON) outputs.
* **Evaluation & Quality:**
  Build evaluation datasets, metrics and automated test suites to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost, and use the results to improve prompts, retrieval and models.
* **Production Engineering:**
  Package and deploy models and services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, add monitoring and logging, and keep them reliable, scalable and cost-efficient in production.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with senior engineers, data scientists and product managers to turn customer and business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions, and contribute to code reviews and design discussions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* **Professional Experience:**
  1–3 years of experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions in production, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on LLM-based applications.
* **Programming:**
  Strong
  **Python**
  skills, with experience writing clean, tested, production-grade code and building REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask).
* **LLM & Agent Frameworks:**
  Hands-on experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex**
  or similar frameworks, and with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or open-source models.
* **RAG & Vector Databases:**
  Practical experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as
  **Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS**
  .
* **Prompting & Structured Outputs:**
  Good understanding of prompting techniques (few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) and of getting reliable structured outputs and function calls from LLMs.
* **ML Fundamentals:**
  Solid grounding in ML and NLP fundamentals, with working experience in
  **PyTorch**
  or a similar framework. Exposure to fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) is a plus.
* **MLOps & Cloud:**
  Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI/CD, and experience deploying on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). Familiarity with LLM observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases) is a plus.
* **Good to Have:**
  Experience with document AI (OCR, invoice or receipt data extraction) or with finance, accounts payable or expense data.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.
  
  
**What you’ll achieve:**

* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI

**About you:**

* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5+ years of experience
* 3+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI-specific threats

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Location: Pune, India
  
  
**About GF**
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
  
  
Introduction
  
  
GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.
  
  
Your Job
  
  

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.

* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.

or SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.

Data & Core Infrastructure Integration

• Model Orchestration: Leverage SAP AI Core and the Generative AI Hub to securely orchestrate,

benchmark, and deploy large language models (LLMs).

• Enterprise RAG: Implement advanced retrieval mechanisms using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),

Core SAP AI Stack

Integration Suite.

• AI Control Plane: In-depth working experience with SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, AI Launchpad, and

Pro-Code & Engineering Frameworks

or Java.

technologies.

Integration & DevOps

Context Protocol).

Generative AI or Agentic AI systems, specifically within an SAP context.

architect certifications.

* Proficiency in PyTorch, including autograd, tensor operations, and custom loss functions.

* Ability to write clean, modular, production-oriented code.

Model Deployment & Inference
  
  

* Experience deploying ML models using Docker and cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GPU-based inference environments.
* Understanding of inference optimization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and KV caching.
* Awareness of model size, latency, and runtime constraints for edge devices.

AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.
